Inherited GABA metabolism disorder defined by developmental impairment, ataxia and epilepsy; hypotonia alone does not establish muscle disease.
Mitochondrial energy-metabolism disorder classified as inherited myopathy; no evidence supplied establishes common additional organ damage across subtypes.

Tumour originates in the uterine cervix, a reproductive organ outside these axes; HPV association does not make the carcinoma an infection.
Lysosomal storage neurodegeneration; progressive retinal degeneration and visual failure affect nearly all typical cases; cardiac involvement is variable and age dependent.
Chronic photosensitive eczema mediated by delayed cellular hypersensitivity; no common extracutaneous organ damage.
Inherited bone fragility with osteopenia and recurrent fractures; hearing impairment reported in 2/8, below 30%; blue sclerae do not establish ocular damage.
Mitochondrial respiratory-chain deficiency; cerebral/cerebellar atrophy, regression and epileptic spasms each reported in 2/2 patients.
Defined neurodevelopmental disorder with intellectual disability and developmental delay; nystagmus and cosmetic or dental features do not establish additional organ damage.
Inherited VWF dysfunction causes defective haemostasis and platelet clearance; bleeding locations do not establish additional organ disease.
Dissection directly damages the vertebral arterial wall; associated cerebral infarction is a separately diagnosed complication.
Inherited alpha-globin disorder; skeletal changes and iron-related organ injury do not apply to most patients across the spectrum.
Rare craniofacial malformation involving cranial and nasal skeletal development; absent definition and phenotypes limit assessment of additional functional organ damage.
Familial steroid-resistant nephrotic disease affects glomerular filtration; minimal-change morphology alone does not establish an immune mechanism in this inherited form.
Late treponemal infection; this umbrella includes latent, gummatous, cardiovascular and neurologic forms, without establishing any damaged organ in at least 30% overall.
Substance dependence has no axis; tobacco-associated pulmonary and cardiovascular diseases are separately diagnosed conditions.
B-cell immunodeficiency; lymphoma, despite occurring in 2/3 reported patients, is a separate malignancy; splenomegaly alone does not demonstrate splenic damage.
Inherited nonsyndromic hearing loss; occasional vestibular dysfunction belongs to the same otologic axis.
Bacterial or fungal infection directly inflames the kidney; the definition overrides the inconsistent uterine parent and synonym.
Defining CNS abnormalities and brain tumour-polyposis phenotype; colonic polyposis in 9/18. Separate haematologic cancers excluded; cafe-au-lait spots do not impair skin.
Cerebral motor-system disorder causing spastic paralysis of one limb; no evidence supplied of common structural muscle or joint damage.
Acquired haemophilia due to factor XI inhibitors is an immune-mediated coagulation disorder; bleeding sites do not establish additional organ disease.
Teratoma originates in the ovary as a reproductive organ; its hair and sebaceous contents do not constitute skin disease or endocrine dysfunction.
Pancreatic malignancy is predominantly exocrine; endocrine carcinoma and lymphoma are minority subtypes and do not determine labels for the umbrella.
